Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.
As informed by learned State Law Officer, notice to the informant has been served on 29.04.2025 but none is present on behalf of the informant.

2. Heard Sri Manvendra Narain Pathak, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Amit Kumar,
learned State Law Officer and also perused the material placed on record.
3.
Applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No. 287 of 2024, under Sections 363, 366, 376(3) of IPC and Sections 3/4(2) of POCSO Act, Police Station Sadar, District Agra, during the pendency of trial.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He has nothing to do with the said offence as alleged in the FIR.
The FIR is delayed by about one day and there is no explanation of the said delay caused.
5. Learned counsel has also stated that the victim is the consenting party as is evident from her statement recorded u/s 164 Cr.P.C.
The victim by her looks seems to be major and as per ossification test report also, her age has come out to be 18 years.
There is no medical corroboration of the incident.
There is no criminal history of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 03.06.2024 and he is ready to cooperate with trial.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

6. Per contra, learned State Law Officer has vehemently opposed the bail application but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant and also the fact that the applicant has no criminal history.

7. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, delay in lodging the FIR, the age of the victim and also considering the statement of the victim recorded u/s 164 Cr.P.C. whereby she seems to be a consenting party, I find it a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant- Aman Khan Alias Arman Khan, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii) The applicant will not pressurise/intimidate with the prosecution witnesses.
iii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed.
9. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

10. It is made clear that observations made in granting bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
Order Date:- 8.5.2025 Siddhant (Justice Krishan Pahal)
